text:
kira: Found a few tiny UX/accessibility issues in Security > Compliance while prepping a sales demo. Not urgent but would improve first impressions. Quick list: 

oscar: Drop them here.

kira: 1) Chip ordering: header shows [region] [encryption] which makes encryption look like a regional attribute. Users read it as "Region: us-west-2, Encryption: true". Suggest: move Encryption chip left of the region badge or change label to `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK)` / `Encryption: Redwood key`.

lia: +1. Also keep chip text short for mobile. If we expand copy, show short text and full text in a tooltip.

kira: 2) Screen reader: the encryption chip currently reads "chip, button". Proposal: aria-label="Encryption: customer-managed key (BYOK). Press for key details." and aria-describedby pointing to a hidden explanation node. When the details panel opens add role="status" to the hint so SR users are informed.

ux-bot: Accessibility note: ensure the chip is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0) and has a visible focus indicator. Add aria-pressed if it toggles a panel.

oscar: 3) Focus ring: current outline is thin and low-contrast. Use a 2px solid accessible color or system focus ring (>=3:1). Also check focus order so the chip is reached before tooltip buttons.

kira: 4) Region fallback badge: right now we show a tiny "fallback" badge with no context. Customers ask why retention differs. Change to `Region: EU (fallback)` with tooltip: "Data stored in EU fallback region due to capacity; retention defaults may differ. See data residency docs." Short for localization.

lia: 5) Audit log exports: events use terse SCREAMING_SNAKE verbs which are inconsistent with UI copy. Example current CSV: `KEY_ROTATE,alice@example.com,2024-11-02T14:32Z`. Proposal to normalize: header `event_time_utc,event,user_email,details` and rows like: `2024-11-02T14:32:00Z,Key rotated,admin@example.com,Customer key rotated to version v3`. This keeps exports readable and explicit about timezone.

ux-bot: Also ensure table rows/headers have proper roles (role=row, role=columnheader) and include aria-sort for sortable columns.

oscar: Small i18n concern: longer chip labels add translation burden. Lia, can you propose 2-line variants (short visible text + expanded tooltip) so translators can keep strings consistent?

lia: Yep. Draft copy: Short: `Customer key (BYOK)` or `Redwood key`. Accessible label (SR): `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK). Press for key details.` Tooltip: `Data stored in fallback region due to capacity; retention defaults may differ.`

i18n-bot: Linking this to ticket UX-1089 for translations. Please avoid punctuation-heavy strings in the short label.

kira: Plan: oscar will mock two chip placements in Figma (left-of-region vs grouped-but-separated). Lia will craft accessible labels + short strings. I'll update the docs screenshot after wording finalizes.

oscar: I'll open a small PR with CSS toggle and an a11y checklist in the PR description. Target: next sprint small patch.

lia: I'll run NVDA + VoiceOver once the PR is up.

ux-bot: Created task UX-1089: encryption-chip-placement + fallback-tooltip + audit-csv-headers (labels: ux, a11y, i18n).

kira: Thanks all 44d. If anyone hits translation or export consumers, ping i18n-bot and ops.
